residual_findings.closure_note: Added architectural comment to combat-engine preset.yaml documenting that load_world's narrative.compute capability call performs the full cycle (read KeyBlocks, invoke WASM, apply state deltas, append timeline events) in a single invocation. The downstream states (apply_delta, advance_timeline) are structural markers reserved for future per-stage capability splits. No code behaviour changed.

residual_findings.title: Partial apply on batch state_delta error — no enclosing transaction; earlier deltas may apply before a later one fails
residual_findings.note: Low risk under current threat model (embedded trusted modules, same-creator worlds). Add transactional apply for untrusted modules in V2.
residual_findings.closure_note: Added threat-model documentation in narrative_compute.rs apply_state_delta explaining why sequential (non-transactional) batch apply is accepted under the V1.61 trusted-module model: all modules are embedded (compiled into binary), compute runs on same-creator worlds, WASM is sandboxed, output is validated before apply. Partial failure means a module logic bug, not a security boundary breach. V2.0+ with user-authored modules should add transaction-aware SqliteKbStore API.
